title: Senior DevOps Engineer
company: Jay Maharaj Software Consulting Pvt Ltd
description:
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 3–5 years  
**Shift:** **3:00 PM to 12:00 AM**  
**Work Mode:** On\-site

**About Us**

JMSC POS is a point\-of\-sale and inventory management platform serving **800–1,000 convenience stores, liquor stores, grocery stores, tobacco shops, and gas stations across the United States**.

Our infrastructure runs entirely on **AWS** and is managed as code using **Terraform**. We are looking for a **Senior DevOps Engineer** to take a key role in maintaining, improving, and scaling our production infrastructure while working closely with our CTO.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Design, manage, and maintain infrastructure as code using **Terraform** across a multi\-account AWS Organization, including Dev, QA, UAT, Production, Sandbox, and DevOps environments.
* Manage and optimize containerized services running on **Amazon ECS Fargate**, including deployments, scaling, performance, and troubleshooting.
* Manage and support **Amazon RDS (MySQL)** environments, including parameter groups, backups, monitoring, performance, and secret rotation using AWS Secrets Manager.
* Design and maintain **AWS VPC networking**, including subnets, security groups, NAT gateways, load balancers, routing, and network security.
* Monitor and maintain infrastructure reliability using **Amazon CloudWatch**, including alarms, logs, dashboards, and operational monitoring.
* Design, maintain, and improve **CI/CD pipelines**, deployment workflows, and Amazon ECR image management.
* Develop, review, refactor, and maintain reusable **Terraform modules** and establish Infrastructure as Code best practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Troubleshoot complex AWS, networking, container, deployment, and infrastructure issues in production environments.
* Implement and maintain appropriate **security, access control, backup, monitoring, and disaster recovery practices**.
* Maintain clear and up\-to\-date technical documentation for infrastructure, deployment processes, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate closely with the **CTO and development teams** to plan and implement infrastructure changes.
* Provide technical guidance and support to team members on AWS, Terraform, DevOps practices, and deployment processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* **3–5 years of professional experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a related infrastructure role.**
* Strong hands\-on experience with **AWS** and production cloud environments.
* Strong working knowledge of **Terraform**, including the ability to design, write, review, and maintain reusable Terraform modules.
* Strong understanding of core AWS services, particularly **RDS, ECS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, ECR, Secrets Manager, and load balancing**.
* Strong understanding of AWS networking fundamentals, including **subnets, security groups, routing, NAT gateways, and load balancers**.
* Hands\-on experience with **ECS Fargate** and containerized workloads.
* Strong knowledge of **Docker** and container deployment practices.
* Experience designing and maintaining **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Strong command\-line/Linux skills.
* Comfortable with **Git and version control workflows**.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of infrastructure, and make well\-considered technical decisions.
* Strong attention to detail and a focus on maintaining reliable and secure production infrastructure.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience managing **AWS Organizations and multi\-account AWS environments**.
* Experience working across Dev, QA, UAT, Production, Sandbox, and DevOps AWS accounts.
* Experience with **AWS Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, ECR, IAM, and automated secret rotation**.
* Experience with **Python or Bash scripting** for automation.
* Experience with infrastructure security and AWS cost optimization.
* Experience with monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident response.
* AWS certification such as **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional** or **AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional**.
* Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to junior DevOps engineers.

**Why Join Us?**

At JMSC POS, you’ll work directly with our **CTO** on real production infrastructure supporting **800–1,000 retail businesses across the United States**.

You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of a broad AWS and Terraform environment and work across **Infrastructure as Code, containers, networking, databases, monitoring, security, CI/CD, and cloud operations**.

This is an opportunity for a DevOps professional who wants to play an important role in building and improving reliable, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure.

Interested candidates can **send their updated CV directly to** **aryanpatel@jmscpos.us**.
